title: Trade the weather
description: A station calls CQ. After reports, use the operator's name and swap weather with WX (weather) and ES (and).

lines.speaker: station
lines.sent: CQ CQ DE K0RAIN K0RAIN K

lines.speaker: station
lines.sent: {MYCALL} DE K0RAIN UR RST {RANDOM_RST} NAME {RANDOM_NAME} QTH {RANDOM_QTH} K

lines.speaker: learner
lines.sent: K0RAIN DE {MYCALL} TNX {RANDOM_NAME} UR RST 579 NAME {MYNAME} QTH TEXAS K

lines.speaker: station
lines.sent: {MYCALL} DE K0RAIN TNX {MYNAME} WX {RANDOM_WX} ES {RANDOM_TEMP} K

lines.speaker: station
lines.sent: {MYCALL} DE K0RAIN TNX FER QSO 73 K

lines.speaker: learner
lines.sent: K0RAIN DE {MYCALL} TNX FER QSO 73 SK
